title: Predicted hidden 'anticamera' linking the north corridor to the Grand Gallery and Big Void

tellings.quote: And that chamber goes directly to the Grand Gallery.

plain: A hidden chamber, an 'anticamera' or antechamber, sits inside the Great Pyramid of Giza and links a passage on its north side to the Grand Gallery, the tall sloping corridor inside the pyramid, and to the 'Big Void', a large hidden empty space reported inside the structure. That is the prediction of the researcher Filippo Biondi. He tells Michels the chamber 'goes directly to the Grand Gallery' and cites no source beyond his own work. If he is right, the pyramid holds a connected set of rooms that has never been entered.
